definition.relevant: Developments affecting Snowflake enterprise data and AI platform demand, consumption, pricing, margins, competitive position or customer security: Snowflake products, cloud and data platform budgets, major enterprise AI deployments, Databricks/BigQuery/Redshift/Microsoft Fabric competition, open table formats, data governance, and material incidents or regulations with an explainable transmission to Snowflake.
definition.irrelevant: Unrelated consumer applications or gaming, generic software/security news without an explainable enterprise data platform impact, and weather or other non-company uses of snowflake.

definition.relevant: IonQ and its acquired businesses, trapped-ion computing performance, fidelity, logical qubits and error correction; competing quantum architectures and commercial cloud adoption; quantum networking; government procurement, funding and DARPA benchmarking; capital, contracts, partnerships or export controls with a plausible material impact on IonQ.
definition.irrelevant: Use of quantum as a marketing metaphor, unrelated physics without an identifiable computing/networking/commercial implication, and quantum-themed consumer products.
